highlights: Glass panels: backdrop-filter: blur(6px) over rgba(255,255,255,0.4) backgrounds used for video play buttons and overlays
Sticky navigation overlay: backdrop-filter: blur(10px) over #faf8f0 background with opacity transitions
Product play button: backdrop-filter: blur(6px) with rgba(255,255,255,0.4) background and circular mask image
Noise texture pattern: 54px noise-pattern.avif overlay on dark backgrounds for subtle grain effect
Glass panel borders: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06) borders with backdrop blur effects
Soft drop shadows on HP phone: multi-layered drop-shadow filters for realistic depth
Sticky backdrop blur overlay: backdrop-filter: blur(8px) over rgba(255,255,255,0.5) for sticky UI elements
